note: Cities the population data alone would miss. Population picks the biggest settlements; a strategy map also needs every theatre to have somewhere to mobilise from.

IDN.reason: Population data leaves Maluku and Papua without a city, so the eastern half of the archipelago cannot build or reinforce anything. Balikpapan, Jayapura, Ambon and Manado replace four Javan and Sumatran cities that duplicate theatres already covered.
